description.narrative: The most significant expected project-level outcome is the increase in access to finance for SMEs, including WSMEs operating in Côte dIvoire. This Project is part of a program of interventions that IFC has been pursuing with several financial institutions in Côte dIvoire with the intention of promoting greater market competitiveness through demonstration and replication effect.

The proposed investment with Bridge Bank Group Côte dIvoire (BBGCI or the Bank) consists of an up to $20 million loan equivalent in EUR. The proposed loan will have a tenor of 2-years. The purpose of this IFC investment is to support BBGCI's lending program to small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs), with a carve-out of 25 percent earmarked for Women-owned/led SMEs (the Project). The Project is being processed under the SME Envelope of the MSME Finance Platform but will not benefit from a Pooled First Loss Guarantee provided by the IDA-20 IFC-MIGA Private Sector Window's Blended Finance Facility (IDA-PSW's BFF).
